stories.headline: Nabers Dodges the Laid-Up List, and His Price Just Struck Gold
stories.read: Word off the New York wire, pardner: Malik Nabers steered clear of the laid-up list and he's fixin' to open Giants camp full-go, no restrictions on the young stud. That washes out the injury discount folks were hopin' to snag, so if you were prayin' he'd tumble down the board, mend that broken heart. He's a locked-in No. 1 who hogs a monster cut of the throws, and a healthy one at that. Draft him where the saloon says and don't blink, 'cause the volume's real and the wagon rolls straight.

stories.headline: Brooks Comes Out Gushin' in Carolina, and the Sleeper Alarm's Ringin'
stories.read: Now here's a vein worth pannin', pardner. Jonathon Brooks strode into Panthers camp a full participant for the first time in his career off two blowed-out wheels, and coach Canales says he 'looks like the guy I remember', fast, strong, and healthy. Chuba Hubbard's still top of the pecking order, but the whisper 'round the ranch is Brooks grabs the reins before the leaves turn. That's cheap gold sittin' way down the board, so stake your claim on the diamond in the rough before the whole outfit catches the scent.

stories.headline: Tuten's Rumblin' Up the Jacksonville Pecking Order
stories.read: Down in Jacksonville a young bronc named Bhayshul Tuten's kickin' up dust, pardner, and the city analysts are already tabbin' him a strike waitin' to gush. He's crowdin' Travis Etienne's cut of the carries, and every rein that slides Tuten's way turns him into a fatter flex play at a bargain-bin price. Etienne fellas, keep one eye on the barn, 'cause the pecking order's shiftin' under ya. Everybody else, go pan that creek while Tuten's still trading cheap.
